title: Why object-oriented programming was introduced
answer: OOP was introduced to help structure growing software around cohesive objects that combine state and behavior, expose clear abstractions, hide implementation details, support modular change, and enable reuse and substitution. The goal is not merely to memorize four pillars; it is to make complex systems easier to understand, extend, test, and maintain. AeroTopo's product model demonstrates this by putting shared product behavior in one abstraction while allowing specialized product types to vary only where needed.
